title: The gene regulatory effects of selective glucocorticoid receptor ligands.
authors: Giroux, Nicholas; Johnson, Graham; Barrera, Alejandro; Reddy, Timothy
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过mRNA-seq和STARR-seq比较多种糖皮质激素受体配体的全基因组基因表达与调控元件活性，评估配体选择性，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅涉及转录因子GR的调控效应，与本课题方法关联弱。
abstract: Synthetic glucocorticoids (GCs), which induce the transcription factor activity of the glucocorticoid receptor (GR), are frequently prescribed anti-inflammatory therapeutics that have been in use for over 70 years. Despite their broad immunosuppressive utility, sustained use of GCs is often intolerable due to the prevalence of adverse side effects. A longstanding goal has been to make synthetic GCs safer by developing selective GR ligands that have similar anti-inflammatory activity but without the burden of side effects. To evaluate the ability of synthetic GCs to target specific subsets of the GC response, we completed a genome-wide comparative analysis of changes in gene expression and gene regulatory element activity in response to ten ligands with various evidence of dissociated adverse side effects. We measured the gene expression response using mRNA-seq and the gene regulatory element response using genome-wide STARR-seq. Effects associated with each ligand were highly correlated with and linearly related to the response to dexamethasone, a strong, non-selective GR agonist used as a positive control for this study. Furthermore, 93% of the variation in regulatory element activity responses could be explained by the efficacy of each ligand alone. We also found limited evidence of differential enrichment of chromatin context-specific markers of regulatory activity with each ligand. Based on those findings, we developed a simulation framework to evaluate selectivity of GR ligands. We conclude that the ligands we tested elicit attenuated molecular responses according to their respective efficacies, and do not selectively target subsets of the molecular GC response.
abstract_zh: 合成糖皮质激素（GCs）通过诱导糖皮质激素受体（GR）的转录因子活性，是已使用超过70年的常用抗炎治疗药物。尽管其具有广泛的免疫抑制用途，但由于不良副作用的普遍存在，长期使用GCs往往难以耐受。一个长期目标是通过开发具有类似抗炎活性但不带来副作用负担的选择性GR配体，使合成GCs更安全。为评估合成GCs靶向GC反应特定子集的能力，我们完成了一项全基因组比较分析，研究了十种具有不同程度解离性不良副作用证据的配体引起的基因表达和基因调控元件活性变化。我们使用mRNA-seq测量基因表达反应，并使用全基因组STARR-seq测量基因调控元件反应。每种配体相关效应与地塞米松（本研究用作阳性对照的强效非选择性GR激动剂）的反应高度相关且呈线性关系。此外，调控元件活性反应中93%的变异可仅由每种配体的效能解释。我们还发现，各配体在染色质上下文特异性调控活性标记的差异富集方面证据有限。基于这些发现，我们开发了一个模拟框架来评估GR配体的选择性。我们得出结论，所测试的配体根据其各自效能引发减弱的分子反应，并未选择性靶向分子GC反应的子集。
